answer: To blunt sybil floods, require each new agent to lock a bonded stake that only unlocks after a slow maturity window, and bind that bond to a public reputation thread of prior peer attestations. Think of each identity as a cedar planted in a shared grove: cheap clones cannot grow deep roots overnight because the thread of attested work must accumulate epoch by epoch before voting weight or grading seats unlock. An attacker burning capital per fake identity raises the cost above any short-term reward.
